result: INCOMPLETE run 1: niji-cc/niji-gcc compile on libniji's headers, packages ship them, P4 tool written; P4 finds 218 C++ failures (__locale_t, cwchar overloads) to fix in run 2

gate.affected: not run (baseline red: 2 of 4 new tests fail on the P4 defects)

rulings.item: libniji's headers declare __locale_t, a reserved name the system C++ library (libstdc++ c++locale.h) needs for <iostream>/<locale>; it is not patchable per package
rulings.recommendation: yes: add it (locale.h family), as a name the toolchain requires, not a glibc-internal name a package relies on

rulings.item: coexist headers at /usr/lib/niji/usr/include (+ x86_64-linux-gnu), not the plan's /usr/lib/niji/include
rulings.recommendation: accept: one both-row per header serves both flavours and the sysroot mirrors / as the libraries do

informational: GCC 13 on the build host knows no -std=c++26/c++2c: the c++26 column of P4 needs GCC 14
trace-at-build probes keep the system headers (NIJI_SYSTEM_HEADERS=1 in tools/hottext/regen.sh): moving them is a start-up layout story

impact.what: P4 matrix: C++ standard headers failing on libniji's headers, found (c++98..c++23)

improvement: Slice 20 should have been preceded by a cheap P4 smoke (<iostream> on libniji's headers) in slice 10: a one-line C++ include would have found __locale_t weeks earlier
next_step: answer the __locale_t ruling, fix locale.h/wchar.h templates until headers_p4.py is 0 FAIL, then P6, P7, plants, gate
